File No. No. 6274
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
October 14, 1929.
Sir,
Enquiries made at the various yamens indicate
that no steamer bearing the name of Kyung Chang 鈞昌
is attached to the local yxxxxx Military and
Police.
Subsequently enquiries reveal that the craft
belongs to the Yeh Shing Tug and Lighter Coy 協興拖駁公司
Ba 36 Avenue Edward VII and the loudah
when questioned stated that at 9 a.m. on October 6
a man named Tsu Ah Yeu 朱阿尤 who is believed to
be an assistant to C.D.S.Tung Ming Teh 董明德 of the
1st district Police Station Nantao came and hired
a launch at $4 per hour.
The launch started from Nantao with about eight
men in plain clothes whom the lcudah believes were
detectives from the Public Safety Bureau. They
were all armed and directed the loudah to steer
for the Hongkew Wharf. There they held up
a sampan occupied by a gang of Hongkew loafers
who had apparently taken delivery of a quantity
of opium from the s.s. "Loongwo". The loafers
seeing the approach of the City Police detectives
threw several bags of the opium into the river
and several of the loafers went ashore and escaped.
The City detectives fired about three shots in the
air, seized the sampan and found only one bag
of opium weighing 500 ounces valued at about $1500.
The launch then took the sampan in tow and returned
to Nantao with the prisoners and opium.
true / Thul

档案编号：6274号
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
1929年10月14日。

先生，

经向各衙门查询，结果显示，当地军警部门并无名为“钧昌”（Kyung Chang）的轮船隶属其下。

随后的调查显示，该船只隶属于协兴拖驳公司（Yeh Shing Tug and Lighter Coy），地址为爱德华七世大道36号B座。当被询问时，该船老大称，10月6日上午9时，一名名叫朱阿尤（Tsu Ah Yeu）的男子前来以每小时4元的价格租用了一艘汽艇。据信此人是南市第一区警察局董明德（C.D.S. Tung Ming Teh）的助手。

汽艇从南市出发，船上载有约八名便衣男子，船老大认为他们是公安局的侦探。这些人均携带武器，并指挥船老大驶向虹口码头。在那里，他们拦截了一艘舢板，船上有一伙虹口闲散人员，这些人显然刚从“龙和”轮（s.s. "Loongwo"）接收了一批鸦片。那些闲散人员看到市公安局侦探逼近，便将几袋鸦片抛入河中，其中几人上岸逃脱。市局侦探朝天开了约三枪，扣押了舢板，仅查获一袋重500盎司、价值约1500元的鸦片。随后，汽艇拖带舢板，将囚犯和鸦片带回南市。

属实 / Thul

pages.en:
File No.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes

As a result of further enquiries it was
ascertained that two detectives named Tung Ming
Teh 董明德 and Wu Zeu Boong 武秀峰 from the Nantao
Police Station led the party responsible for the
seizure of the opium, They made no report of
the occurrence to their Chief but they settled
the case for a bribe of $1500 and released the prisoners.
I have not been able to ascertain the names
of the prisoners but they are believed to be the
former followers of Liang Hung 梁宏 and are now
reported to be attached to the gang under Hsu Foh 许福寶
Pau a professional gambler and a leader of loafers.
Hsu whose name I mentioned in my report on the case
of the kidnapper Zao Zai Hsi 赵才喜 (arrested by
West Hongkew in connection with the kidnapping
of the son of Chen Ping Him) has been arrested
and detained at Sinza Station in connection with
another kidnapping case.

J.C.S.
Information might be
given confidentially to
Col. Liang. What about
John Kotg's suggestion?
R.W.P.
D.C.I.

Chu Kaoliang
Clerical Assistant.

Sir Col Yuan Liang informed
25/10/29. Tan.

档案编号：
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记

经进一步查询，查明由南市警察局的两名侦探董明德（Tung Ming Teh）和武秀峰（Wu Zeu Boong）率领的队伍负责查扣了这批鸦片。他们未向其主管报告此事，而是以1500元贿赂私了此案，并释放了囚犯。

我未能查明囚犯的姓名，但据信他们是梁宏（Liang Hung）的前部下，现 reportedly 依附于许福宝（Hsu Foh Pau）团伙。许福宝是一名职业赌徒，也是闲散人员的头目。我在关于绑架犯赵才喜（Zao Zai Hsi）一案的报告中曾提及此人（赵因绑架陈炳钦之子一事被西虹口捕房逮捕）。许福宝另涉一起绑架案，已被捕并关押在新闸捕房。

J.C.S.
可将此情报机密地告知梁上校。John Kotg 的建议如何？
R.W.P.
副刑事侦缉处长

朱嘉良（Chu Kaoliang）
文书助理

袁良上校已于1929年10月25日获知此事。Tan.
